sources.content: # brindlecache image. This image packages Brindlecache, a small HTTP caching proxy written in Go. It builds on `gcr.io/distroless/static-debian12` and runs as the non-root user with UID 65532. The proxy listens on port 8080 for client traffic and exposes Prometheus metrics on port 9090. The entrypoint is `/usr/local/bin/brindlecache serve`, and any extra arguments passed to `docker run` are appended to it. The image contains no shell, so debugging requires the separate `-debug` tag.

Configuration. Set `BRINDLE_UPSTREAM` to the origin URL the proxy should forward misses to; the container exits with code 2 if it is missing. `BRINDLE_CACHE_SIZE_MB` controls the in-memory cache and defaults to 256. `BRINDLE_TTL_SECONDS` sets how long entries live and defaults to 300. Mount a volume at `/var/cache/brindle` and set `BRINDLE_DISK=1` to spill entries to disk when memory fills. Logs go to standard output in JSON format, one object per line.

claims.text: The brindlecache image runs as the user with UID 65532.
The brindlecache proxy listens on port 9090 for client traffic.
The brindlecache image is published for both amd64 and arm64.
The brindlecache container exits with code 2 if BRINDLE_UPSTREAM is missing.
